title: The crash site
content: When I read about this MallWorld shared universe my skin crawled. I have been to the supermarket with the big toy section; the staircases that lead nowhere; the curvy highways that go up and down; the underground rail station that connects to a weird airport; and a locker room in a pool. Some of the greatest hits, basically. Now, let me go back a bit, to when I was 5 or 6. Allegedly I had recurrent dreams that ended in me screaming and shouting. I think it was my first introduction to the mall world. The only thing I remember is that I was on a plane, a very vivid plane. Flash forward 15 years and I am living a double life as a person in the real world and as a MallWorld citizen, exploring its bits and corners. BUT ONE BIT that I have never heard anyone talk about is that there is also a trekking section, and in that I HAVE FOUND A WRECKAGE that I do not know what belongs to, but it may as well be a plane. I am dumbfounded. Did I die in a planecrash in a previous life or something? Has anyone of you found this particular trekking area?
